Chapter 5. Web website. 2. Introduction to the Application MS LDS® is a Document Management Software which is used to store and track electronic documents in multiple languages. It has document versioning control and approval workflow system. The software supports all required functions and facilitates the work in quality management.

Hardware and Software requirements Microsoft Windows operating system (XP, Window 7) Software Microsoft .NET framework 4.0 Office 2007 or Office 2010 Memory 1024 MB RAM Hardware Hard disk 10 GB HDD Below you will find the interface of MS LDS® application.

Step 2: Select the existing server connection or click New to define a connection to the server. Step 3: Select the language from the Choose language dropdown list box. 3.6 Document In MS LDS® a document could exist in one of the following states: Draft – A new document when created with the Draft status. Verified – Once document is finalized the user will approve it and change the status to Verified. Released – A verified document can only be released. Published – Publish a document to display it in MS LDS® Web. Edit – Document status changed to edit if a Verified/Released/Published document is edited. On Check-in of edited document “Reason to edit” is mandatory to enter. Entering three or more spaces will allow check-in edited document without “Reason to edit” comments. Blocked – Block a document to change status to Blocked. On Block operation entering

“Reason to Block” the document is mandatory. User can use three or more space to skip the reason to block. Blocked documents are not useable in MS LDS® as well as in MS LDS® Web. Expired – Document status changed to Expired when expiration date exceeded. Expiration date is assigned to all released/published documents. After expiration document need to be edited and a new version will be released. Document Process Flow Notes: Only after the document is released in the main language, it can be verified and released in other languages. Once the document is published in the main language, then only it can be published in other languages. In case of changes the main document version will remain same till the updated document is

released. Once released the updated version gets automatically updated in all languages and a mail regarding the version changes is also sent to all the concerned persons. If the document is blocked in main language it gets automatically block in all other languages. In MS LDS® web the document will not be accessible and a message will displayed “Document is blocked. Please contact Administrator. Once a document is expired it will remain accessible in MS LDS® and MS LDS® Web. Edit the expired document to release a new version of the document. If changes are done in Master Language document, then similar changes will be automatically updated in all other languages on release of the master document. In other
language, if user clicks on the previous version of the document a message box with the following message is displayed,<<New release of the document exists>>.
